## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dutiyanāvāvimānavatthu* ("Second Ship Mansion", Vv 7) is a canonical poem in the *Vimānavatthu* collection of the Khuddaka Nikāya. The text centers on the karmic fruition of generosity, conveying that the simple act of offering water to the Noble Saṅgha generates boundless happiness and rebirth in a heavenly mansion.

 DharmaNexus strongly confirms the close relationship with Vv 6 and Vv 8, recording near-verbatim text reuse across the entirety of Vv 6 (§0.1–11.1 at 0.97 similarity) and extensive alignment with Vv 8 (§0.1–10.4 ↔ §0.1–12.4 at 0.91 similarity) [DharmaNexus].
